decisions.statement: An order is read from the mail Amazon sent rather than from Amazon's own site.
A mail naming no order number is no order and is passed over rather than refused.
An order number is the three-seven-seven shape Amazon writes.
Money is read into cents so that a total compares against a transaction's amount.
The bidirectional marks Amazon writes into a subject are struck before the subject is read.
A summary is the text the subject says after its first colon.
An item with no stated price is kept with no price rather than dropped.
A date that cannot be parsed is refused rather than read as nothing.
Nothing here reaches Amazon or Gmail.

definition: an Amazon order read out of the confirmation mail Amazon sends
